purpose: A single-page interactive onboarding experience for a newly appointed IQAC SPOC. It explains what IQAC is, when major activities occur, what documentation areas exist, and how the audit cycle progresses.
scope: Onboarding only. Not a dashboard, ERP, live tracker, document-management system, login system, or AI assistant.
research_basis: SPOC needs to understand timeline and expectations.
SPOC tracks documents, follows up, verifies evidence, coordinates audit remarks/corrections and preserves records.
Research identified fragmented documentation, repeated reminders, incomplete documentation, retrieval difficulty, unclear correction ownership and deadline pressure.
source_priority: Never invent institutional requirements, dates, names or official wording.
final_outcome: The new SPOC leaves with a mental model of the system rather than a pile of instructions.
